title: Cadillac of Norwood Ice Arena
specs: Originally built as training facility for US Women’s Olympic Hockey team
Two ice sheets: one NHL sized and one Olympic sized
Home to Express Junior Hockey team
No roller blades, scooters or skateboards allowed
No rough playing or ball throwing allowed
No outside food or beverages allowed in the rink
Only players and coaches allowed in locker rooms
includes: Use of party space for pizza, cake, gifts, etc.
Live and on-demand online broadcasts of events
gap: Public skating and hockey hours not stated
blurb: Cadillac Ice Arena has two ice sheets, one NHL sized and one Olympic sized, used for hockey, figure skating, and speed skating. It hosts the Express Junior Hockey team and offers birthday party packages with on-ice time and party space. The arena also provides live and on-demand online broadcasts of events.
extraNote: USA Hockey’s Zero Tolerance Policy Regarding Parents & Spectators enforced · Inappropriate behavior leads to removal and possible disciplinary action · No food or cameras allowed in locker rooms
